title: Deciphering the history of ERK activity from fixed-cell immunofluorescence measurements.
authors: Ram, Abhineet; Pargett, Michael; Choi, Yongin; Murphy, Devan; Teragawa, Carolyn; Cabel, Markhus; Kosaisawe, Nont; Quon, Gerald; Albeck, John G
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ERK信号通路动态与效应蛋白表达的关系，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The RAS/ERK pathway plays a central role in diagnosis and therapy for many cancers. ERK activity is highly dynamic within individual cells and drives cell proliferation, metabolism, and other processes through effector proteins including c-Myc, c-Fos, Fra-1, and Egr-1. These proteins are sensitive to the dynamics of ERK activity, but it is not clear to what extent the pattern of ERK activity in an individual cell determines effector protein expression, or how much information about ERK dynamics is embedded in the pattern of effector expression. Here, we evaluate these relationships using live-cell biosensor measurements of ERK activity, multiplexed with immunofluorescence staining for downstream target proteins of the pathway. Combining these datasets with linear regression, machine learning, and differential equation models, we develop an interpretive framework for immunofluorescence data, wherein Fra-1 and pRb levels imply long-term activation of ERK signaling, while Egr-1 and c-Myc indicate more recent activation. Analysis of multiple cancer cell lines reveals a distorted relationship between ERK activity and cell state in malignant cells. We show that this framework can infer various classes of ERK dynamics from effector protein stains within a heterogeneous population, providing a basis for annotating ERK dynamics within fixed cells.
abstract_zh: RAS/ERK通路在许多癌症的诊断和治疗中发挥核心作用。ERK活性在单个细胞内高度动态，并通过效应蛋白（包括c-Myc、c-Fos、Fra-1和Egr-1）驱动细胞增殖、代谢及其他过程。这些蛋白对ERK活性的动态变化敏感，但尚不清楚单个细胞中ERK活性的模式在多大程度上决定效应蛋白的表达，也不清楚效应蛋白表达模式中嵌入了多少关于ERK动态的信息。在此，我们利用活细胞生物传感器测量ERK活性，并与通路下游靶蛋白的免疫荧光染色进行多重分析，评估这些关系。通过将这些数据集与线性回归、机器学习和微分方程模型相结合，我们开发了一个用于解释免疫荧光数据的框架，其中Fra-1和pRb水平暗示ERK信号传导的长期激活，而Egr-1和c-Myc则指示更近期的激活。对多种癌细胞系的分析揭示了恶性细胞中ERK活性与细胞状态之间的扭曲关系。我们表明，该框架可以从异质群体中的效应蛋白染色推断出不同类别的ERK动态，为在固定细胞中注释ERK动态提供了基础。
